sn40.6:1.4: idha bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn40.6:1.6: so khohaṃ āvuso sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.6:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato ākāsānañcāyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.6:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn40.6:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ pamādo viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi viññāṇañcāyatane cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.6:2.4: so khohaṃ āvuso aparena samayena sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.6:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya …pe… mahābhiññataṃ pattoti.
